thread:
Sam L.: Heads up — a production marketplace PO hit finance and was rejected. Finance says cost_center doesn't match our ERP mapping (AWS PO shows RDW-SALES, ERP expects RDW-PLATFORM). Can partnerships + finance weigh in?
Priya C.: Ugh. Which vendor/account is this?
Sam L.: It's the AWS Marketplace PO for acct acct-0192 (reseller flow). PO#: 2026-7063. Vendor won't change the cost_center on their side — marketplace fixed payload. Our accept job throws: "unknown cost_center RDW-SALES" so it never creates the vendor invoice.
Taylor N.: We're stuck on our end, procurement needs a valid invoice/PO match to pay. Vendor says the only way is for us to accept RDW-SALES as an alias. Is that allowed?
Marco R.: Short term we can add an alias mapping in the billing system (map RDW-SALES -> RDW-PLATFORM) so the ingest pipeline treats it as platform. Prefer not to make permanent.
Ana P.: Finance can do manual mapping for this specific vendor invoicing cycle but we need documented approval from Legal and Partnerships. Also need to attach SOC2 evidence before we release payment per procurement checklist.
Sam L.: SOC2 link: https://files.redwood/example-soc2-2025.pdf (already uploaded to contract folder). Procurement flagged we must attach it to PO record.
legal-bot: automated-check: marketplace T&C review required if we alter PO acceptance behavior. Logging request: LR-3172.
Riya (Legal): I can sign off on a temporary alias for up to 30 days while vendor engages their marketplace onboarding team. Need the alias and expiration logged in the contract notes. Also confirm that this doesn't change revenue recognition mapping.
Priya C.: Proposed temp fix (ops): add internal alias in billing with expiry. Example command: `erp_alias add "AWS:acct-0192:RDW-SALES"=RDW-PLATFORM --expires 2026-04-30 --ticket LR-3172`
Taylor N.: I'll attach the SOC2 and the LR-3172 note to the PO, then request Finance to re-run ingestion. Can procurement expedite once docs in place?
Ana P.: Yes — if alias is created and SOC2 attached, we can mark as ready-for-payment and run a one-off ingest. Please add contact for audit trail.
Marco R.: I'll create the alias now and include audit comment mapping to the marketplace partner and ticket LR-3172.
Sam L.: Thanks. Quick ask: can someone confirm the downstream impact for usage billing (aren't cost centers tied to cost reports)? Need to ensure analytics teams get the alias mapping.
Riya (Legal): From legal POV OK. Finance to confirm accounting mapping but this is operational alias only; it doesn't change legal entity. Please capture in the contract folder and Slack thread. :thumbsup:
Priya C.: Noted — tagging @analytics to get the alias reflected in cost exports.
Taylor N.: I'm attaching SOC2 now and will ping procurement.
Ana P.: Confirmed — once alias + SOC2 present I'll trigger ingest. ETA 2 hours.
Sam L.: Great — I'll follow up with vendor onboarding to push a longer-term fix. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
